# AUTO-GENERATED Men-at-Arms scripted_guis — do not edit by hand
# One spawner effect per MAA key

### Huscarl Spawner
DI_huscarl_effect = {
	scope = character

	effect = {
		random_owned_story = {
			limit = {
				story_type = DI_misc_variables_story
			}
			save_scope_as = DI_story
		}
		
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:DI_story = { has_variable = DI_pinned_char_var }
			}
			every_living_character = {
				limit = { has_character_flag = pinned_for_edit }
				save_scope_as = target

				spawn_army = {
					men_at_arms = {
						type = huscarl
						men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value
					}
					location = scope:target.location
					inheritable = no
					name = huscarl
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			spawn_army = {
				men_at_arms = {
					type = huscarl
					men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value
				}
				location = root.location
				inheritable = no
				name = huscarl
			}
		}
	}
}

					inheritable = no
					name = sjalvolki_berserkers
				}
			}
		}
		else = {

### Darksteel Bombards Spawner
DI_darksteel_bombards_effect = {
	scope = character

	effect = {
		random_owned_story = {
			limit = {
				story_type = DI_misc_variables_story
			}
			save_scope_as = DI_story
		}
		
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:DI_story = { has_variable = DI_pinned_char_var }
			}
			every_living_character = {
				limit = { has_character_flag = pinned_for_edit }
				save_scope_as = target

				spawn_army = {
					men_at_arms = {
						type = darksteel_bombards
						men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value
					}
					location = scope:target.location
					inheritable = no
					name = darksteel_bombards
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			spawn_army = {
				men_at_arms = {
					type = darksteel_bombards
					men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value
				}
				location = root.location

			save_scope_as = DI_story
		}
		
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:DI_story = { has_variable = DI_pinned_char_var }
			}
			every_living_character = {
				limit = { has_character_flag = pinned_for_edit }
				save_scope_as = target

				spawn_army = {
					men_at_arms = {
						type = stoneforged
						men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value
					}
					location = scope:target.location
					inheritable = no
					name = stoneforged
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			spawn_army = {
				men_at_arms = {
					type = stoneforged
					men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value
				}
				location = root.location
				inheritable = no
				name = stoneforged
			}
		}

### Fog Spirits Spawner
DI_fog_spirits_effect = {
	scope = character

	effect = {
		random_owned_story = {
			limit = {
				story_type = DI_misc_variables_story
			}
			save_scope_as = DI_story
		}
		
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:DI_story = { has_variable = DI_pinned_char_var }
			}
			every_living_character = {
				limit = { has_character_flag = pinned_for_edit }
				save_scope_as = target

				spawn_army = {
					men_at_arms = {
						type = fog_spirits
						men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value
					}
					location = scope:target.location
					inheritable = no
					name = fog_spirits
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			spawn_army = {
				men_at_arms = {
					type = fog_spirits
					men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value
				}
				location = root.location
				inheritable = no
				name = fog_spirits
			}
		}
	}
}

				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			spawn_army = {
				men_at_arms = {
					type = elite_undead
					men = scope:DI_story.var:DI_army_spawner_increment_value
				}
				location = root.location
				inheritable = no
				name = elite_undead
			}
		}
	}
